test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: According to the passage, which of the following statements is correct?

options.text: In 1989-90, Karnataka’s per capita income was higher than that of Bihar’s.
In 1989-90, Karnataka’s per capita income was equal to that of Bihar’s
In 1989-90, Bihar’s per capita income was higher than that of Karnataka’s.
In 1989-90, Karnataka’s per capita income was higher than that of the other southern states.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Statement: *In 1989-90, Karnataka’s per capita income was higher than that of Bihar’s.***

 
 
• This statement is **correct** as per the passage, which explicitly states, "Karnataka’s per capita income at ₹2,055 a year was almost two times that of Bihar."
 
 
 
• **Statement: *In 1989-90, Karnataka’s per capita income was equal to that of Bihar’s.***
 
 
• This statement is **not correct** as the passage mentions that Karnataka’s per capita income was almost two times that of Bihar in 1989-90.
 
 
 
• **Statement: *In 1989-90, Bihar’s per capita income was higher than that of Karnataka’s.***
 
 
• This statement is **incorrect** according to the passage, which states the opposite – Karnataka's per capita income was almost two times higher than that of Bihar in 1989-90.
 
 
 
• **Statement: *In 1989-90, Karnataka’s per capita income was higher than that of the other southern states.***
 
 
• This statement is **not addressed** in the passage. The passage only compares the per capita incomes of Karnataka and Bihar.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.
